StoveDetector

A sensor that notices when a stove has been left on and unattended, and sounds an alert before it becomes a fire. Started as a personal safety fix (formerly "KitchenEye"); now a hardware startup heading into its first pilot homes.

Custom carrier board, Wi-Fi alerts, and a pre-pilot FCC compliance process I'm running myself.
